envelope.description: Extract the reviewer lookup and add the new fields to the review view

body.title: Extract the reviewer lookup and add the new fields to the review view
body.summary: Make resolveReviewer in the companion header module from the inline fallback and have the header use it. Add docPath, contentVersion, feedback, reviewer and state to the review view.
acceptanceChecks: resolveReviewer gives the git name, else the OS login, else unknown, with its source
The companion header's user text is unchanged
The view returns the five new fields and its existing fields are unchanged
The daemon's typecheck and the existing review-view tests pass with the new fields

tests.name: reviewer: resolveReviewer gives the trimmed git name with source git, else the OS login with source os, else unknown, and resolveCompanionHeader's user is unchanged for the same inputs
review view: docPath, contentVersion, feedback, reviewer and state are returned, the existing fields are unchanged, and a changed markdown gives a different contentVersion
